requirements.title: Health-research pseudonymisation showing
requirements.question: Whether the researcher has shown that the health research cannot reasonably be carried out with pseudonymised information

source.quote: A research ethics committee may approve research only where the researcher has shown that the research cannot reasonably be carried out with pseudonymised information.
